Marcus/Team — short triage summary after initial log review:
- Error signature matches OOM/GPU backpressure patterns plus a surge in RPC timeouts from endpoints serving the customer's dedicated pool.
- Dedicated pool for Greenline is at 92% GPU utilization with several long-running KV-heavy chats (increasing KV cache pressure).
- We see prefix-cache eviction spikes correlating with latency jumps.

Immediate mitigations (can be executed now, ~15-30 minutes):
1) Enable temporary burst capacity (non-billed hot-fork) to add 2 nodes to the customer's pool for 60 minutes to relieve queueing.
2) Activate short-term routing to an equivalent-compatible quantized model variant (slightly lower perf) for non-critical scoring paths to reduce per-token compute.
3) Increase max-concurrency limit per-worker to reduce queuing, paired with a tighter batching window for short queries.

Medium-term (this week):
- Investigate root cause of KV eviction pattern and adjust KV cache sizing + autoscaling policy for this reserved pool.
- Add a per-customer circuit-breaker to fallback to lower-cost model variant earlier when queue length > threshold.

I will start the burst action now if @sean confirms node availability and @marissa signs off on customer messaging.

Regards,
Irene Choi
